name: Space Beach Youth Camp
what_you_do: Explore aerospace jobs in a free six-day camp. You tour companies and training sites, meet engineers and tech workers, and do hands-on activities.
who_can_apply: Ages 17 to 21. The city's program list also says you must meet WIOA in-school youth rules. Ask the center what that means for you.
pay_detail: Free. The page does not list any pay.
deadline_text: Last cycle: applications were due Jul 8, 2026, and the camp ran Jul 21 to 30, 2026. Dates for 2027 are not posted as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: Last cycle used an online form on the camp page. Check there for the next one, or call 562.570.4700.
notes: These are 2026 dates, because 2027 dates are not posted. The page does not promise another camp. It was held at 508 W. Willow St., Long Beach.
